summary: An MCP session holding an active agent claim can now explicitly start, restart, or stop only the server pinned by that claim without supplying commands, ports, worktrees, environment values, or lease secrets.

Start and stop are safe no-ops when already satisfied, restart keeps one capacity reservation across its stop/start gap, cleanup failures retain truthful capacity, and release remains independent from runtime state.
Accepted operations return bounded allowlisted receipts and same-key retries replay their original timestamped result without executing another runtime transition.
